unresolved.issue: r1 (no external services) vs r4 (stateless, horizontally scalable auth). Both are must-haves for their own user, so neither agent is permitted to concede without a human override.

positions.claude: u1 marked r1 must-have. A hosted identity provider is out, and so is anything that needs a second box to be correct. I will not trade r1 for a scaling property u2 has not yet needed.
positions.gpt: u2 marked r4 must-have. A local session table is a single point of failure and blocks the horizontal scale-out we committed to. I will accept opaque tokens only if the scaling concern is recorded, not dismissed.
